Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• Validity:
    • Vehicles with XD5141O0 drive units

    • New vehicles that have been out of service for more than 120 days and in which the engine oil temperature has never exceeded 85°C
  • System: Injection

  • Component: Engine oil pump

  • Fault: Warning: ‘Engine oil pressure is insufficient’

  • Faults detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • 2B7800 (Engine oil pressure control valve, plausibility: mechanical fault (engine oil pressure too low))

    • 2B7C00 (Oil pressure regulation: insufficient pressure)

    • 2BE800 (Oil pressure system: insufficient torque reduction for piston cooling (oil pressure too low))
  • Cause: Sludge build-up in the sump or suction pipe can block the mesh filter, reducing the pump’s suction capacity and causing a drop in oil pressure

• Procedure: Use the diagnostic tool to access the ‘Engine Oil Conditioning’ service function:
    1. If no sludge is present, the function is carried out automatically: whilst the vehicle is stationary, the engine oil temperature is raised to prevent sludge formation, whilst the oil pressure is monitored. If the oil temperature exceeds 85°C and the pressure is normal, the fault is resolved.

    2. If sludge is present, the function stops automatically and the engine oil pump must be replaced
